cards.title: H01 HEAD · Frontal Neutral
cards.action: Neutral relaxed expression, lips softly closed, calm direct gaze into the camera, head level and facing the camera straight-on.
cards.camera: Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible

cards.title: H02 HEAD · Soft Smile
cards.action: Soft closed-mouth smile: the corners of the lips gently raised, the cheeks slightly lifted, relaxed eyes, warm direct gaze into the camera, head level and facing the camera straight-on.
cards.camera: Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible

cards.title: H03 HEAD · Laugh
cards.action: Laughing naturally: mouth open showing the upper teeth, cheeks raised high, eyes narrowed from laughing, head level and facing the camera.
cards.camera: Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible

cards.title: H04 HEAD · Mouth Open
cards.action: Mouth open in a relaxed natural way: the jaw loosely dropped, lips parted, the upper teeth visible, eyebrows relaxed, gaze into the camera, head level and facing the camera straight-on.
cards.camera: Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible

cards.title: H05 HEAD · Eyes Closed
cards.action: Both eyes fully closed with relaxed eyelids and the lashes resting, calm serene expression, lips softly closed, head level and facing the camera straight-on.
cards.camera: Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible

cards.title: H06 HEAD · Looking Away
cards.action: Head turned about 30 degrees toward the LEFT edge of the image, the eyes looking far off toward the LEFT edge of the image, not at the camera, neutral relaxed expression, lips softly closed.
cards.camera: Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible

cards.title: H07 HEAD · Slight High Angle
cards.action: Camera slightly above eye level, tilted down about 15 degrees: the top of the forehead is closer to the camera and appears larger than the chin. The person looks slightly up into the camera, neutral relaxed expression, lips softly closed.
cards.camera: Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible

cards.title: H08 HEAD · Slight Low Angle
cards.action: Camera slightly below the chin, pointing up about 15 degrees: the jawline and chin are closer to the camera, the underside of the nose is slightly visible and the forehead appears smaller. The person looks slightly down into the camera, neutral relaxed expression, lips softly closed.
cards.camera: Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible
